semanticRoles.name: --borda-campo
semanticRoles.purpose: Edges of fields, options and person messages (5.89:1 on panel, 7.42:1 on black).

semanticRoles.name: --realce-borda
semanticRoles.purpose: Selected option, highlighted contact, result box, status box, risk message, accent-color.

numeral.purpose: Report statistics in destaque-texto, tabular figures.

headline.purpose: Section h2; same weight family as the call block's main line.

label.purpose: Nav links, field labels, options; notes and hints at 400 in texto-2.

focus.name: anel-foco
focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible ring; inputs use a 2px offset.

motion.name: ease-surgir
motion.purpose: Shared easing for message entry and FAQ icon rotation.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Contacts to two columns; statistic rows to numeral + description.

schemes.name: light
schemes.purpose: Inverted ground; yellow fills kept; yellow text and outlines go black.

schemes.name: more-contrast
schemes.purpose: texto-2, linha and borda-campo collapse to texto.

schemes.name: forced-colors
schemes.purpose: 2px CanvasText border on every filled surface; heart mark to CanvasText.

narrative.overview:
A quiet stadium at night. The ground is pure black, the type is white and very bold, and exactly one thing is lit: the way to help. Yellow (#FFC400) is the floodlight; it falls on the call to 1414, on the primary action, and on the focus ring, and almost nowhere else. Everything around it stays dark, flat and calm so a visitor in distress, on a phone, finds the next step without searching.

The page is a single editorial column of large Poppins ExtraBold headlines over generous DM Sans body text at 18px. Density is low on purpose: sections are separated by deep vertical rhythm and a thin, 22%-white hairline, the halfway line of a pitch, with its centre circle drawn once under the opening. Panels in #1E1E1E with 1rem corners hold the interactive parts (screening, assistant, contacts); they are lifted by tone, never by shadow.

Accessibility is a design input, not a layer: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast is verified per pair, targets are at least 44px, focus is a 3px ring, and the system ships a light scheme, a `prefers-contrast: more` scheme and a forced-colors fallback. The page must never resemble a betting site: no neon, no red/green signalling, no odds-board glare.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground, white type, one yellow for action and attention.
Poppins 800 headlines with tight negative tracking; DM Sans body at 1.125rem / 1.6.
Single 46rem column; deep, fluid section spacing.
Flat: tonal panels and hairlines, no shadows.
Pitch-line hairlines as the only ornament.
Every state works in dark, light, more-contrast and forced-colors.

rules.name: The One Floodlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow is reserved (campaign report §4.4: heart, alerts, buttons, help number; §15.1: the data number large and yellow as focal point). It appears only as filled actions, the focus ring, the selection/highlight border (realce-borda), the brand heart mark, and, on dark ground only, as text for the attention role (destaque-texto): the help number 1414 and the three report numerals. Never other decoration.

rules.name: The No Yellow Text On Light Rule
rules.body: Yellow is never text on a light background (1.6:1 on white). Any role that uses yellow text in the dark scheme must switch to black in the light scheme, as destaque-texto, foco and realce-borda already do.

rules.name: The Hairline Is Not A Boundary Rule
rules.body: linha is decorative (below 3:1). Anything a person must perceive (field edges, option edges, selected states, errors) uses borda-campo, texto or realce-borda at 2–3px.

rules.name: The Root Size Rule
rules.body: html stays at 100% and every size is rem or a rem-based clamp, so the reader's own font-size setting scales the whole system. Body never drops below 1rem.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from size and Poppins weight (700/800), never from colour or uppercase. No letter-spaced uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Importance is shown by light (yellow fill, yellow or black highlight border), never by elevation. A surface that matters more gets brighter, not higher.

dos: **Do** keep yellow (#FFC400) for filled actions, the focus ring, highlight borders, the heart mark, and, on dark ground, the 1414 number and report numerals; text on yellow is always black.
**Do** switch every yellow-as-text or yellow-outline role to black in the light scheme.
**Do** verify contrast for every new pair and keep secondary text at #9A9A94 on dark and #555550 on light (all pairs above 5.8:1).
**Do** give every interactive element at least 44px of target and a 3px focus ring with 3px offset.
**Do** separate sections with espaco-seccao and a 1px linha hairline; keep the single 46rem column.
**Do** size everything in rem or rem-based clamp(), body at 1.125rem / 1.6, lines at 65ch.
**Do** gate motion behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep it under 250ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
**Do** add a 2px CanvasText border under forced-colors to any new filled surface.
donts: **Don't** use yellow as text on a light background (1.6:1).
**Don't** use yellow for decoration, section accents or large fills other than actions; outside fills, yellow is limited to the heart mark, the 1414 number and the report numerals.
**Don't** add box-shadows or elevation; depth is tone and border only.
**Don't** use red/green signalling or neon colours, or anything that reads as a betting interface.
**Don't** use the linha hairline as the only edge of something a person must perceive.
**Don't** set body text below 1rem or fix the root font size in px.
**Don't** introduce letter-spaced uppercase labels; rank comes from Poppins size and weight.
